description: This is a test class for the CandidateShortlistingAPI in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It contains unit tests for API endpoints related to candidate shortlisting, including methods for getting, updating, and deleting candidate shortlisting data, though some methods are expected to throw 'not implemented' exceptions.

classes.name: CandidateShortlistingAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CandidateShortlistingAPI endpoints related to recruitment candidate shortlisting features.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific tables related to CandidateHistory before each test.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests that calling getOne() on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests that getValidationRuleForGetOne() throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a candidate shortlisting record using mock data and services.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test case data for the testUpdate method from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that delete() throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that getValidationRuleForDelete() throws a 'not implemented' exception.
